name: DEEP Resilience Center Luxembourg West
notes: DEEP states that private racks are available in its three Tier IV-certified datacenters in Windhof, Kayl and Betzdorf; LU-CIX lists Resilience Center Luxembourg West at 3 rue Pierre Flammang, L-8399 Windhof, which is in Capellen canton.

name: C2D System House Windhof
notes: Facility directory DCHub reports an operational Windhof data center operated by C2D System House Luxembourg SA with 3.0 MW power; C2D's own site markets sovereign IT hosting in Luxembourg.

name: LuxConnect Bettembourg Campus DC1.1/DC1.2/DC1.3
notes: LuxConnect lists three carrier-neutral Tier IV facilities at 202 Z.A.E. Wolser F, L-3290 Bettembourg, with 3,100 m2, 1,300 m2 and 5,500 m2 net space; DCD reported the larger Bettembourg campus capacity as 18 MW.

name: DEEP Resilience Center Luxembourg South
notes: DEEP identifies Kayl as one of its three Tier IV-certified Luxembourg datacenters; LU-CIX lists the facility at 210 rue de Noertzange, L-3670 Kayl.

name: Datacenter Luxembourg S.A. Bettembourg
notes: Datacenter Luxembourg's site describes secured server room services in a Tier IV data center; FEDIL and Paperjam list the company at 202 Z.A.E. Wolser F, L-3290 Bettembourg and describe it as a datacenter/cloud/Internet infrastructure provider.

name: DEEP Resilience Center Luxembourg East
notes: DEEP lists Betzdorf as one of its Tier IV-certified datacenters; LU-CIX locates Resilience Center Luxembourg East at the audiovisual and communications zone in L-6922 Betzdorf. DCD reported the Betzdorf facility opened with 5,000 sq m of white space.

name: European Commission Betzdorf Datacentre
notes: The European Commission announced/inaugurated its new Betzdorf datacentre after moving out of the Jean Monnet building; the source describes it as an energy-efficient, flexible and secure datacentre enhanced by cloud services.

name: Portus Data Centers Luxembourg
notes: Portus describes its Cloche d'Or underground Tier IV Luxembourg city facility with 2.4 MW critical IT load and 2,600 m2 white space; its 2024 announcement says an expansion adds 1,350 m2 and raises total IT load capacity to 3.4 MW.

name: Visual Online Contern Datacenter
notes: Visual Online states it owns a modern data centre located at Contern, Luxembourg, connected to redundant high-speed fiber and multiple tier operators.

name: BCE Colocation Luxembourg / Broadcasting Center Europe Kirchberg
notes: LU-CIX lists BCE as a datacenter location at 43 boulevard Pierre Frieden, L-1543 Luxembourg; Datacenterplatform reports BCE Kirchberg with 908 m2, 360 racks and 3 MW connection capacity.

name: DATA4 Luxembourg
notes: DATA4 describes itself as a European data center campus operator; Datacenterplatform lists DATA4 Luxembourg at 8 Rue Henri M. Schnadt, L-2530 Luxembourg, with 3,000 m2, 1,200 racks and 4 MW connection capacity.

name: Telkea 1 Rue de Bitbourg Data Center
notes: Baxtel lists an operational Telkea Group data center at 1 Rue de Bitbourg in Luxembourg; Telkea's own site confirms its ICT and telecom services presence at the same address.

name: Verizon Luxembourg / LMEXLU Contern
notes: Verizon's Luxembourg terms identify Verizon Business Security Solutions Luxembourg SA at Rue de l'Etang 4A-B, L-5326 Contern; facility directories list Verizon LMEXLU/Verizon Luxembourg as a data center at 4 Rue de l'Etang, Contern.

name: LuxConnect Bissen DC2
notes: LuxConnect lists DC2 at 3 op der Poukewiss, ZAC Klengbousbierg, L-7795 Bissen, with 21,000 m2 gross space, 4,800 m2 net space and 2 x 12.6 MVA power available; LU-CIX also lists the Bissen/Roost facility.

name: Google Bissen data center project
notes: Google bought 33.7 ha in Bissen in 2017 for a long-running data center proposal. RTL reported in November 2025 that a building permit application had been submitted and the project had been scaled down; Chronicle reported in 2026 that the building permit procedure had occurred while the operating permit remained pending.
